findings.harness_license: Pinned SWE-bench LICENSE confirms MIT. That does not supply license terms for every underlying repository or dataset record.
findings.verified_card: The pinned dataset card lists 500 issue/PR pairs and gold/test patches, but declares no license field. Its prose says only issue/base are present despite the listed gold fields; inspect the actual versioned dataset schema before mapping.
findings.data_boundary: Never send patch, test_patch, FAIL_TO_PASS, PASS_TO_PASS, future cases or expected outcomes to the task worker. No dataset rows or task corpus have been downloaded or chosen.
findings.compatibility: SWE-bench is a possible optional full-repository test-pack adapter. The existing bounded Python-callable grader is not its harness and is not claimed compatible.
findings.storage: No storage shortage blocks this correction. No benchmark images are proposed or provisioned here. The upstream whole-suite recommendation cannot substitute for a measured subset footprint and the existing 50 GiB reserve.
findings.scope: Read-only metadata/source inspection. No upstream code, installer, harness or benchmark task executed.
